findings.desc: B-0315 changes the DONE build/version-bump gate so packages/main/tests/** is a watched capability-proof input (done-effects.ts returns true and version-bump-smoke asserts that positive case), but worktree-authority-smoke still keeps packages/main/tests/smoke.ts in the skipped set and asserts isDoneMainRuntimeBuildInput(path) === false. That leaves a core authority smoke encoding the opposite product boundary from this story, so the bounded strategy is not consistently reflected and will fail or mislead gate verification when that smoke runs.
